state:

Stage 9 file set 1 is closed: no `about.md` under `docs/examples/` outside `tools/php-differences` says what it replaces in PHP, so `no-about-md-says-what-it-replaces-in-php` is green. Every `about.md` under `docs/examples/core/` and `docs/examples/types/` names PHP nowhere. Under `lang/` and `tools/`, PHP is named only where the page is about a PHP habit: the `what-does-not-exist`, `*-that-do-not-parse` and `refused-in-expression-position` pages, the `<?php`/E0229 lines, `enums/what-replaces-php-s-enum-members` and the two `tools/agents` pages. `docs/examples/README.md` § *The description* no longer invites the hint.

The other three Stage 9 checks are red and are the next group onwards: the registry text, the website components and the concept page.
